title: [7/11/2024] Number of immigrants to three countries

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the number of immigrants entering three different countries, namely the USA, Canada and Australia, over a 10-year period between 1991 and 2001.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while the number of immigrants to the USA declined sharply after 1992, the figures for both Canada and Australia remained relatively stable throughout the period. Additionally, the USA consistently maintained the highest numbers of immigrants among the three countries.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the US figures, the number of immigrants started at approximately 1,500,000 in 1991 before reaching its peak of about 1,800,000 people the following year. However, this was followed by a sharp decline to roughly 1,000,000 in 1993, after which the figures remained relatively stable between 700,000 and 900,000 for the rest of the period, ending at around 900,000 in 2001.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the other two countries, Canada began the period with about 200,000 immigrants, and this number increased gradually to approximately 450,000 by 2001. Meanwhile, Australia maintained the lowest and most stable figures, fluctuating slightly around 100,000 throughout the entire period.
